item.title: Bali Targets 7.2M Foreign Tourists, Rp150k Levy Maintained
item.description: Bali Governor Wayan Koster projects 7.1-7.2 million foreign tourist arrivals in 2026. Supported by culture and a Rp150,000 levy, Bali remains Indonesia's tourism gateway.
item.content:encoded:
Projected 7.2 Million Foreign Tourists to Bali

Bali Governor Wayan Koster projects foreign tourist (wisatawan mancanegara or wisman) arrivals to Bali throughout 2026 to reach 7.1 million to 7.2 million visits. That figure exceeds the 2025 achievement recorded at 7.05 million visits, while demonstrating the resilience of Bali's tourism amid global geopolitical uncertainties.

The projection was conveyed by Koster when opening the 15th Regional Conference (Musyawarah Daerah or Musda) of the Association of the Indonesian Tours and Travel Agencies (ASITA) Bali at the InterContinental Bali Hotel, Jimbaran, Badung Regency, on Friday (10/16/2026).

According to official data from the Bali Provincial Government, foreign tourist arrivals from January to September 30, 2026, have reached 5.2 million visits, an increase compared to the same period in the previous year. 'Based on existing data, I estimate that by the end of this year foreign tourist arrivals will exceed the 2025 achievement. The estimate is around 7.1 million to 7.2 million visits,' Koster said.

Backbone of Bali's Economy

The tourism sector contributes approximately 66 percent to Bali's Gross Regional Domestic Product (Produk Domestik Regional Bruto or PDRB), making it the backbone of the regional economy. Nearly 45 percent of all foreign tourist arrivals to Indonesia are recorded entering through the Island of the Gods.

With an average tourist expenditure of 122 United States dollars per day, foreign exchange contributed by Bali tourism is estimated to reach Rp176 trillion — roughly 55 percent of Indonesia's total tourism foreign exchange earnings. Given this contribution, Koster urged the central government to formulate national policy schemes that are more supportive of Bali's tourism development and management.

Rp150,000 Levy for Foreign Tourists

Since February 14, 2024, every foreign tourist entering Bali has been subject to a Rp150,000 levy — around 10 United States dollars — per visit, known as the Bali Levy. The levy is paid once per arrival, online prior to departure via lovebali.baliprov.go.id or at airport arrival counters accepting non-cash payments.

The levy funds are allocated for environmental conservation and the preservation of Balinese culture. This policy applies to all foreign tourists including children, and the rate remains unchanged through 2026. Tourists must also account for the visa on arrival fee of approximately Rp500,000 (30 days), which is separate from this levy.

Culture as a Magnet, Sustainability as a Challenge

Koster emphasized that the primary strength of Bali's tourism does not lie solely in its natural beauty, but rather in the richness of its customs, traditions, arts, and culture that attract tourists from across the globe. He reminded industry players not to focus merely on arrival numbers and economic profits, but to also take part in safeguarding cultural heritage and the environment so that Bali tourism thrives sustainably over the long term.

Behind the growth projections, the regional government highlighted several challenges: orderly structuring of the tourism industry, fair business competition, waste management, and energy self-reliance. Koster reiterated that all stakeholders must understand how to build, safeguard, and nurture Bali tourism.

item.title: US Teacher Freed from Russian Prison, Allegedly Tortured for 4 Years
item.description: US teacher Stephen Hubbard (74) was released from a Russian prison on October 21, 2026, after being detained since 2022. Former Ukrainian prisoners held alongside him accused Hubbard of being tortured — beaten, electrocuted, and forced to crawl.
item.content:encoded:
Free at the Witkoff-Putin Meeting

Stephen Hubbard, a 74-year-old retired teacher from Michigan, was released from a Russian prison on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, after being detained for more than four years. His release took place on the sidelines of a meeting between US President's special envoy Steve Witkoff and Russian President Vladimir Putin in St. Petersburg.

The Kremlin called Hubbard's release a "humanitarian gesture." President Donald Trump said he had asked Putin to free Hubbard in an early October phone call. Hubbard was flown to San Antonio for a medical examination after his release.

Mercenary Charges and a Nearly 7-Year Sentence

Hubbard was captured by Russian forces in 2022 from his home in Izyum, Kharkiv region, Ukraine, and in October 2024 was sentenced to nearly seven years in prison — precisely six years and 10 months — in a closed-door trial on charges of fighting as a mercenary for Ukraine.

The US government under the Biden administration designated Hubbard as "wrongfully detained," and the family denies the allegations — they say Hubbard had no military or political ties during his stay in Ukraine since 2014.

Testimony of Torture from a Former Ukrainian Prisoner

The heaviest allegations come from Ihor Shishko, a former Ukrainian prisoner of war who was held alongside Hubbard from September 2022 to May 2024 in two Russian prisons: Novozybkov in the Bryansk region and the Pakino No. 7 prison colony in the Vladimir region.

In a letter to The Times, Shishko alleged that Hubbard — the only US citizen detained — was targeted because of his nationality. He accused authorities of beating Hubbard daily, subjecting him to electric shocks, forcing him to crawl like a dog, and sexually abusing him. Shishko said he bandaged Hubbard's knees, whose skin had been scraped raw from being forced to crawl on the prison floor.

Criticism Over Witkoff's Praise and the Fate of Other Prisoners

Shishko sharply condemned Witkoff's remark to Putin — "You are a humanitarian also, sir" — as "shameful and disgusting," and demanded an apology for his ignorance.

The testimony aligns with statements made by Hubbard's sister, Patricia Hubbard Fox, to AP: her brother was starved and beaten so severely that fellow prisoners had to carry him, and the guards knew only three words of English: "Die, American. Die." According to his sister, Hubbard did not even realize he had been freed until he saw the US flag inside the aircraft.

Hubbard is the second US citizen freed by Russia in about two months, after Marine veteran Robert Gilman in August. According to the advocacy group Global Reach, five other US citizens remain detained in Russia.

item.title: Breaking: Trump Ready to Scrap 50% Tariff on Canada Ahead of Midterm…
item.description: The White House officially issued a proclamation on Friday (10/23/2026) lifting the 50% tariff on certain Canadian products — plywood, paper, refrigeration machinery, packaging — effective October 30, 2026, to help Senator Susan Collins ahead of the U.S. midterm elections. A new 50% tariff will be imposed on carpets, valves, and waste products so that the total affected remains ~US$20 billion.
item.content:encoded:
Latest Developments

The White House officially issued a proclamation on Friday (10/23/2026) U.S. time lifting the 50 percent tariff on certain agricultural and forestry products from Canada, according to a document published on the White House website and reported by The Wall Street Journal. The tariff change takes effect on October 30, 2026.

The exempted products cover five main groups: plywood sheets, certain paper products, certain machinery and refrigeration equipment, crates and packaging boxes, and fresh and dried seaweed — according to a White House document cited by WSJ. In her statement, Collins named nine product categories she fought for, including agricultural machinery, refrigeration equipment, packaging products, and goods used in food production, with blueberry, potato, apple, and seaweed producers among the beneficiaries. Collins said she had repeatedly requested tariff relief and emphasized the burden of additional costs borne by businesses and families in Maine.

As an adjustment, the new 50 percent tariff applies to a range of other Canadian goods — including carpets, certain valves, and waste products. The adjustment keeps the total value of Canadian goods hit by the 50 percent tariff at around US$20 billion, meaning the overall trade-war pressure has not eased.

This step is explicitly intended to help Collins and a number of Republican candidates in the northern border states hardest hit by the trade war, ahead of the US congressional midterm elections on November 3, 2026. Collins is in a tight race against Democrat Troy Jackson, who has made Trump's trade war with Canada a central campaign issue.

WSJ Report Triggered the Proclamation

A Wall Street Journal report published Friday (10/23/2026) served as the official trigger: President Donald Trump's administration issued a proclamation revoking the 50 percent tariff on certain agricultural and forestry products from Canada, with the change taking effect October 30, 2026. The tariff reduction was offset by an increase in levies on other Canadian products, according to a White House document cited by WSJ.

A White House official previously said any tariff announcement would come directly from the administration and that preliminary reports were merely speculation; the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative declined to comment. Now the official proclamation has replaced that speculation.

Political Payback for Collins

This move is aimed at helping Collins and a number of Republican candidates in northern border states hit hardest by the trade war, ahead of the November 3, 2026 midterm elections. Collins, who is running for a sixth term, is in a tight race against Democrat Troy Jackson in Maine, which leans Democratic.

Jackson made Trump's trade war with Canada a central issue in his campaign, given that Maine's economy relies heavily on trade with Canada, from auto parts and lumber to fruit-picking equipment. Michigan and Maine are both battleground states in the fight for control of the U.S. Senate.

Collins' criticism of the 50 percent tariff is something he has voiced for a long time. He warned that a trade war could threaten thousands of jobs in the state.

Tariff War Since August

The trade dispute began in late August 2026 when the White House invoked Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, known as Smoot-Hawley, to penalize Canadian imports. A 50 percent tariff was imposed on approximately US$20 billion worth of Canadian goods, and Ottawa retaliated with countermeasures and threats of additional tariffs on automobiles.

Last month, the US exempted some products but at the same time raised tariffs on others, leaving the total trade affected nearly unchanged. The planned tariff overhaul now comes amid growing pushback, including a lawsuit this week from a New Jersey food importer challenging the legality of using Smoot-Hawley authority for the levies.

Response and Subsequent Impact

With the proclamation now officially issued, this tariff relief is no longer speculation. However, the White House continues to balance it with a new 50 percent tariff on other Canadian goods, leaving the total volume of affected trade nearly unchanged — the same pattern as last month's overhaul.

The November 3, 2026 special election will be the real test: the Kalshi prediction market puts the Democrats' chances of sweeping Congress at 67 percent, a figure that explains the political urgency behind this move. For Indonesia, this development serves as a barometer of US trade protectionism tensions, which also affect global commodity markets. The editorial team will monitor Ottawa's response and the realization of the policy effective October 30.

item.title: SKK Migas Cuts Gas Exports to Singapore by 31 BBTUD
item.description: SKK Migas officially cut natural gas exports to Singapore by 31 BBTUD starting Saturday, October 24, 2026 — 15 BBTUD from Natuna and 16 BBTUD from Sumatra (Jambi Merang). The policy announced by SKK Migas Head Djoko Siswanto aligns with Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources Bahlil Lahadalia's plan to overhaul the national gas export allocation for domestic industrial needs.
item.content:encoded:
Cuts Take Effect Starting Today

Indonesia officially cut natural gas exports to Singapore starting today, Saturday, October 24, 2026. The decision was made by the Special Task Force for Upstream Oil and Gas Business Activities (SKK Migas) with a total reduction volume of 31 BBTUD (billion British thermal units per day).

On the sidelines of the 2026 Subroto Energy Award Gala Night hosted by the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources at The Westin, Jakarta, on Friday night, October 23, 2026, SKK Migas Head Djoko Siswanto announced the cut, effective starting this Saturday. "This reduction is specifically intended for the pipeline route connected directly there, and there is no similar adjustment for exports to other countries," Djoko emphasized.

Details: Natuna 15 BBTUD, Sumatra 16 BBTUD

Supply reductions were carried out from two main distribution points through pipeline networks. From the Natuna region, the gas allocation sent to Singapore was cut by 15 BBTUD, while from the Sumatra region — specifically the Jambi Merang Working Area — it was reduced by 16 BBTUD.

Djoko emphasized that the cut targets only Singapore. "There is none (cuts to other countries), the pipeline only goes to Singapore," he said in response to a question about the possibility of adjustments to other partner countries.

So far, Singapore has imported Indonesian natural gas through an undersea pipeline network sourced from offshore gas fields in South Sumatra, Natuna, and the Riau Islands.

Bahlil Overhauls Gas Export Allocation

This step by SKK Migas runs parallel to the plan of Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources Bahlil Lahadalia — who also serves as Coordinating Minister for Downstreaming and Energy Transition — to recalculate the national gas export share.

Bahlil stated he will conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the national gas supply allocation because gas is a crucial raw material, especially for the development of the downstreaming industry and the petrochemical sector domestically, he said at the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources Office in Jakarta.

Bahlil said that currently around 30 percent of national gas production is still exported, while 70 percent is allocated for domestic needs, including as a raw material for downstreaming.

This policy aligns with the directive of President Prabowo Subianto, who emphasized the importance of national resilience and self-reliance in managing state resources amid a volatile global geopolitical situation.

Three Days from Discourse to Execution

The speed of this policy's execution is unusual. The idea of restructuring gas exports was first raised by Bahlil on October 21, 2026, at the State Palace, and the cuts were already in effect three days later, on October 24, 2026.

Bahlil previously also stated that the government is considering not extending gas export contracts to neighboring countries if domestic public and industrial needs have not been optimally met. SKK Migas itself had previously studied the possibility of a moratorium on pipeline gas exports to Singapore after the contract expires.

As an illustration of scale, pipeline gas export volumes to Singapore in 2025 were recorded at around 200 million cubic feet per day — equivalent to roughly 200 BBTUD — meaning the 31 BBTUD cut equals about 15 percent of that volume. What has drawn market attention is not the size of the volume, but the precedent: the 30 percent export share is now a variable that can move.

item.title: M7.2 Earthquake Hits Vanuatu, Tsunami Warning Issued
item.description: An M7.2 earthquake hit waters 200 km west of Sola, Vanuatu, on Saturday. The PTWC issued a tsunami threat for areas within 300 km; no casualties were reported.
item.content:encoded:
Shallow Earthquake 200 Km From Sola

The United States Geological Survey (USGS) reported that a magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck offshore Vanuatu, an island nation in the South Pacific Ocean, on Saturday (24/10/2026). The tremor occurred at 02:31 UTC or 13:31 local time — equivalent to 09:31 WIB (Western Indonesian Time).

The epicenter was located about 200 kilometers west of Sola, Vanuatu, at a depth of just 10 kilometers below sea level. Shallow earthquakes such as this tend to be felt more intensely and have the potential to cause greater damage compared to deeper quakes of the same magnitude.

As of the initial report, the USGS had received only two felt reports from residents. The affected region is a sparsely populated island area in northern Vanuatu, and initial earthquake parameters remain automated pending analyst review.

Tsunami Warning Within 300 Km Radius

The Hawaii-based Pacific Tsunami Warning Center (PTWC) issued a tsunami threat message following the earthquake. Based on initial assessments, hazardous tsunami waves could reach coastal areas within a 300-kilometer radius of the epicenter.

As of this initial report, there is no information regarding casualties or damage resulting from the earthquake. Authorities continue to monitor the situation on the ground.

Vanuatu lies on the boundary between the Australia and Pacific tectonic plates, making it prone to earthquakes. In the past 30 days alone, 25 earthquakes above the reporting threshold have been recorded within a 250-kilometer radius of this epicenter, the largest measuring magnitude 6.9.

item.title: BYD Atto 1 Crashes into 4 Cars, Hits Ride-Hailing Driver in Blok M
item.description: An electric BYD Atto 1 crashed into 4 cars and struck an online motorcycle taxi driver in South Jakarta on Friday (23/10/2026). Police are investigating.
item.content:encoded:
Multi-Vehicle Collision in Blok M Area

A multi-vehicle collision involving a BYD Atto 1 electric car, four cars, and a motorcycle occurred on Jalan Panglima Polim, Blok M area, Kebayoran Baru, South Jakarta, on Friday (23/10/2026) at 16:48 WIB (Western Indonesia Time). The incident caught public attention after video footage went viral on social media.

According to an official statement by the Head of Accident Section, Law Enforcement Subdirectorate, Directorate of Traffic of Polda (Regional Police) Metro Jaya Police Commissioner Kharisma Arbita Bangsa, the BYD car with license plate number B-1220-KDP driven by a man with the initials S (46) was heading from south to north before the chain collision occurred. Police stated the initial suspicion was that the driver lacked caution and concentration, but the exact cause is still under investigation.

Police Version of Chronology

The accident began when the BYD struck a Honda Brio with license plate number B-2967-NGY traveling in the same direction ahead of it, directly in front of the Win Hotel. Following the initial collision, the vehicle swerved to the left and struck a Honda Beat motorcycle with license plate number A-3867-DD ridden by an ojol (online motorcycle taxi) driver with the initials HS.

The chain collision continued: the BYD slammed into a Wuling car with plate number B-1835-ERZ that was stopped on the left side of the road, mounted the sidewalk, and hit two cars parked in the Amaris Hotel area, specifically a Honda Mobilio with plate number B-1247-WZK and a Toyota Navi with plate number B-2447-TWB.

Ride-Hailing Driver Suffers Fractures, Rushed to Fatmawati Hospital

As a result of the crash, the ojol driver HS (56) fell from his motorcycle and was run over by the BYD car. He suffered a fractured left leg along with abrasions. His Honda Beat motorcycle was also damaged.

The victim was subsequently rushed to Fatmawati Hospital to receive medical treatment. 'The victim suffered injuries with a broken left leg and abrasions. Receiving treatment at Fatmawati Hospital,' Police Commissioner Kharisma Arbita Bangsa said.

Driver Secured by Residents, Cause Under Investigation

Meanwhile, the BYD driver, identified as S, was apprehended by local residents at the scene. In videos circulating on social media, S was seen being pulled out of the car and struck by residents before ultimately being handed over to Polres (City/Regency Police) Metro Jakarta Selatan. Satlantas (Traffic Unit) of Polres (City/Regency Police) Metro Jakarta Selatan is questioning S to determine the exact cause of the accident.

'The tentative suspicion regarding the cause of the accident is currently under investigation,' Kharisma said. The investigation remains underway to confirm the factors that triggered the multi-vehicle crash.

item.title: DPR Agrees Karhutla to Be Classified as Ecological Terrorism,…
item.description: The Indonesian House of Representatives' Commission IV supports the government's plan to classify deliberate forest and land fires as ecological terrorism. The provision is being prepared for inclusion in the revision of the Forestry Law, which has already been harmonized at the Legislative Body, with criminal sanctions strengthened for corporations and masterminds behind forest burning. Commission XII is urging the sealing of sites and sanctions for natural restoration.
item.content:encoded:
DPR Commission IV Agrees, Included in Forestry Law Revision

The Indonesian House of Representatives' Commission IV supports the government's plan to classify deliberately set forest and land fires (karhutla) as ecological terrorism. The support was conveyed by Commission IV member Daniel Johan on Saturday (24/10/2026), who assessed that existing criminal penalties have not had a deterrent effect.

"Deliberate forest and land fires are not merely administrative violations or ordinary crimes," said Daniel. According to him, the impact of forest and land fires destroys ecosystems, disrupts the health of millions of citizens, paralyzes economic activity, and becomes a burden on the country's reputation in the eyes of the world.

The PDIP politician assessed that the regulation of ecological terrorism could be included in the revision of the Forestry Law so that its regulation is integrated and does not overlap with other regulations. "This regulation must target perpetrators who deliberately burn in an organized and large-scale manner," he said, while emphasizing that the rule is not aimed at small-scale farmers or indigenous communities carrying out traditional practices.

Revision Already Harmonized, Just Awaiting Presidential Letter

Deputy Speaker of Commission IV of the House of Representatives (DPR) Alex Indra Lukman stated that his commission is open to the government's plan and has prepared the pathway for it. The revision of the Forestry Law is said to have been completed in Commission IV and has been harmonized at the Legislation Body (Baleg).

"We have completed the revision of the Forestry Law, the next step is the Presidential Letter," said Alex, Saturday (24/10/2026). Commission IV is now waiting for the government to discuss the revision, and the issue of ecological terrorism can be included during the deliberations.

Daniel Johan added that the DPR is ready to discuss it with the government openly and carefully so that the new regulation is truly effective in protecting forests, rather than merely adding terminology. Upstream prevention must still be carried out, from strengthening patrols, peatland restoration, to assisting farmers so they can clear land without burning.

Commission XII: Seal the Site, Mandate Nature Restoration

From Commission XII, DPR member Ateng Sutisna (PKS) urged enforcement beyond mere administrative fines. He stressed that authorities must take firm action against forest burners without compromise and require environmental restoration as the primary sanction.

"The government has the right to seal or temporarily shut down [the site] before any court ruling," Ateng said in Jakarta on Saturday (24/10/2026). According to him, sealing the location points that are the source of the fire is important to break the risk of subsequent fires while the investigation is ongoing.

Ateng argues that material fines will never be commensurate with the ecological devastation caused by fire, especially on peatland. Corporations and individuals proven guilty must absolutely bear the responsibility of rehabilitating the damaged landscape, because the biodiversity and soil microorganisms that have been destroyed are extremely difficult to restore.

Background: Prabowo's Order and Latest Forest Fire Data

The discourse on ecological terrorism began with President Prabowo Subianto's directive to the Minister of Forestry and the Minister of Environment to strengthen law enforcement against environmental destruction. Law Minister Supratman Andi Agtas said the government is opening the option of revising legislation to categorize forest and land fires as ecological terrorism.

The context is the still-expanding forest and land fires. BNPB recorded 2,204 disaster events in Indonesia from January 1 to October 23, 2026, the majority of them hydrometeorological disasters. The forest and land fires currently being handled in Kalimantan cover 18,973 hectares — Central Kalimantan the largest at 16,097 hectares, followed by South Kalimantan at 1,506 hectares and West Kalimantan at 1,370 hectares — while in Sumatra they cover 2,431 hectares with South Sumatra the largest at 2,050 hectares.

item.title: 12 Residents Detained After Looting Snacks From Burning Warehouse in…
item.description: Police have detained 12 residents suspected of looting snacks from two warehouses that burned down on Jalan Bumi Ayu Raya, Bengkulu, after video of the act went viral on social media. The fire on Thursday night (22/10/2026) also killed Febriansyah, the warehouse head; the cause of the blaze and the role of the suspects are still under investigation.
item.content:encoded:
Two Warehouses Burn, One Warehouse Head Dies

A massive fire engulfed two shophouses (ruko) being used as warehouses on Jalan Bumi Ayu Raya, Bumi Ayu Village, Selebar District, Bengkulu City, on Thursday night (22/10/2026) at around 23.41 WIB. The growing flames spread from a snack warehouse to an adjacent flour warehouse.

The fire department deployed 10 personnel with a total of 12 vehicles to the location and immediately carried out localization to prevent the fire from spreading to other buildings. The fire was successfully extinguished at around 03.00 WIB on Friday (23/10/2026), after which the handling of the location was handed over to the police.

On Friday morning, officers found a man dead inside one of the warehouses, lying near the stairs leading to the toilet. The victim was identified as Febriansyah, the warehouse head tasked with guarding the warehouse. Police are still investigating the cause of the fire as well as the sequence of events that led to the victim being found dead at the scene.

Viral Video of Looting, 12 People Detained

After the fire was extinguished, the scene of the blaze was instead marked by residents taking items from the warehouse. In a video that went viral on social media, several people were seen breaking through police lines and carrying off large quantities of snacks, even using sacks.

Some residents chose to return the items they had taken after being reprimanded by other residents, but others still carried away strings of snack packets from inside the warehouse after the fire.

Following up on the circulating video, the Criminal Investigation Operational Unit of the Selebar Police Precinct moved in and detained 12 people suspected of being involved on Friday (23/10/2026) at around 16.00 WIB. They came from diverse backgrounds — housewives, casual daily laborers, to students, including minors. Police also seized a number of snacks suspected to have been taken from the scene.

Status Still Suspected, Investigation Continues

Police are still investigating the role of each of the 12 people detained to determine their involvement. "The incident cannot yet be declared a proven criminal act of looting," as emphasized in the report, so the presumption of innocence remains paramount for the suspects.

Selebar Police Chief AKP Bayu Heri confirmed the discovery of a body at the fire scene and stated that the investigation into the cause of the fire is still ongoing. "Items remaining after the fire remain under the authority of their owner," read the advisory emerging from this case.

This case serves as a reminder for residents not to take items from disaster sites without the owner's permission and to continue complying with the security lines set up by authorities.

item.title: Jorge Martin Withdraws from Australian GP After Suffering a Fracture
item.description: Jorge Martin is confirmed to be absent from the main MotoGP race at the Australian Grand Prix 2026 at Phillip Island Circuit, Sunday (25/10/2026), after suffering a broken right arm in a sprint race crash, Saturday (24/10/2026). X-ray results showed a right radius fracture and a suspected ulna fracture, and the Aprilia team stated Martin is not fit to race.
item.content:encoded:
Falls at Turn 8 During Duel with Marquez

Jorge Martin had to end his 2026 Australian MotoGP weekend early after suffering a massive crash in the sprint race at Phillip Island Circuit on Saturday (24/10/2026). The Aprilia rider fell on the eighth lap of 13 while engaged in a fierce battle with Marc Marquez for the win.

Martin lost control of his motorcycle at Turn 8 and crashed at high speed. He was thrown across the gravel trap on the side of the track before being evacuated on a stretcher by marshals and taken to the circuit medical center for examination.

Before the crash, Martin had been competitive throughout the sprint. He briefly led the race on lap three and continued trading positions with Marquez until the incident at Turn 8 halted his progress.

Aprilia Confirms Martin to Miss Main Race

X-ray results confirmed a serious injury to Martin's right arm. Aprilia confirmed a fracture of the right radius bone and a suspected fracture of the right ulna bone at the distal end. The medical team then declared Martin unfit to compete in the main race on Sunday (25/10/2026).

In a team statement, Aprilia confirmed the decision. "Martin has been declared unfit to compete in tomorrow's race," the team said in a statement cited from the race report.

Martin still needs to undergo further examinations to get a definitive assessment of his condition. Martin's absence is a major blow for Aprilia, which is now relying on Marco Bezzecchi as the team's best representative after he finished fourth in the sprint.

The Championship Title Is Drifting Further Away from Martin

The MotoGP Australian sprint race was won by Marc Marquez of Ducati. Alex Marquez of BK8 Gresini Racing finished second, 0.323 seconds behind, while Fabio Di Giannantonio of Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team finished third, 0.590 seconds back.

The sprint result changed the map of the 2026 MotoGP world championship battle. Martin, who began the sprint with a two-point lead over Marquez, now trails his rival by 10 points, a 12-point swing that hurt the Spanish rider.

The Australian MotoGP main race will be held at Phillip Island on Sunday (25/10/2026) without Jorge Martin on the track. Marquez, who also secured pole position in the qualifying session, now holds full control in the title fight.

item.title: Toyota Rush Hits 5 Pedestrians in Sukabumi, 1 Killed
item.description: A Toyota Rush struck five pedestrians on Sukabumi-Bogor Road, Parungkuda, Sukabumi on Saturday (24/10/2026), leaving one person dead and four others injured.
item.content:encoded:
Early Morning Crash in Parungkuda

A fatal accident occurred on Jalan Raya Sukabumi-Bogor, specifically in Kampung Pangadegan, Desa Sundawenang, Parungkuda District, Sukabumi Regency, on Saturday (24/10/2026) at around 01:00 WIB (Western Indonesian Time). A Toyota Rush car hit five pedestrians on the left road shoulder, leaving one person dead and four others injured.

Head of the Law Enforcement Unit (Kanit Gakkum) of Traffic Corps (Satlantas) at Polres (City/Regency Police) Sukabumi, Second Police Inspector (Ipda) Wangsit Edhi Wibowo, explained that the car bearing license plate F 1206 QE was traveling from Parungkuda toward Cibadak. Arriving at the scene, the driver was suspected of lacking focus toward the left side of the road. 'Upon arriving at the crime scene, the driver was suspected of lacking concentration to the left of the road, then struck five pedestrians who were on the left side of the road,' Wangsit said.

After striking the pedestrians, the car only came to a halt after crashing into a tree on the left side of the road. The successive collisions resulted in the victim dying at the scene, while the injured victims immediately received assistance.

One Dead, Four Slightly Injured

The deceased victim was identified as M. Yosep (22), a resident of Kampung Cibarengkok, Desa Darmareja, Nagrak District. He suffered severe head trauma, bleeding from his ears and nose, as well as bruising to the abdomen, and was pronounced dead at the scene.

Four other pedestrians sustained minor injuries. They are Risman (23), Agus Sopiandi (33), Nurman Nudin (19), and Sirojudin (25). Their injuries included lacerations to the head and temples, abrasions, and bruises across several parts of their bodies.

All victims, both deceased and injured, were immediately evacuated to RSUD (Regional General Hospital) Sekarwangi Cibadak to receive medical treatment. Police confirmed that road conditions at the crash site were fairly good, featuring a straight asphalt surface, clearly visible markings, and fair weather when the collision occurred.

Police Handle Case, Material Losses at Rp10 Million

The driver of the car, Eggianto Cahya Ramadhan (30), is identified as a university student from Sukmajaya, Depok City. Police are still examining statements from the driver and witnesses at the scene to ascertain the sequence of events prior to the accident.

Material losses resulting from this accident are estimated at Rp10 million. The accident case is currently under intensive investigation by Satlantas Polres (City/Regency Police) Sukabumi.

This accident serves as a reminder for motorists to constantly maintain focus while driving, especially during early morning hours when alertness tends to decline. Pedestrians are also advised to exercise caution even when walking along road shoulders.

item.title: CATL Battery Factory in Karawang Ready to Be Inaugurated by Prabowo
item.description: The electric vehicle battery ecosystem plant of PT CATIB in Karawang, a collaboration between battery giant CATL and Indonesian state-owned enterprises, has been completed and is awaiting the inauguration schedule of President Prabowo Subianto. With an initial capacity of 6.9 GWh and an investment of US$6 billion, the plant marks Indonesia's leap from a raw nickel exporter to a player in the global battery supply chain.
item.content:encoded:
Waiting for the President's Schedule

Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources Bahlil Lahadalia confirmed that the electric vehicle battery ecosystem factory in Karawang has been fully completed and is ready to be inaugurated. "It is ready to be inaugurated. We are just waiting for the right time from the President. The factory is finished," Bahlil said at the Presidential Palace Complex, Jakarta, Monday (19/10/2026).

The facility was built through a partnership between China's CATL and an Indonesian state-owned enterprise, with the groundbreaking ceremony led by President Prabowo Subianto about a year earlier. Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources Secretary-General Ahmad Erani Yustika confirmed that the battery cell plant developed by PT CATIB has been operational — the commissioning and gradual operation phase has been underway since August 2026.

US$6 Billion Dragon Project

PT CATIB was established as a joint venture between Indonesia Battery Corporation (IBC) and Ningbo Contemporary Brunp Lygend Co. Ltd. (CBL) — a consortium of Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited (CATL), Brunp, and Lygend. The investment value of the project, dubbed the Dragon Project, is estimated at US$6 billion, or approximately Rp98.58 trillion.

The production facility stands in the Artha Industrial Hills (AIH) area, Karawang Regency, on a 43-hectare plot of land, encompassing a module & pack plant as well as a cell plant. "CATIB's capacity in this first phase is 6.9 GWh and we will soon expand it to at least 15 GWh," said Aditya Farhan Arif, President Director of IBC. The conversion of 15 GWh is equivalent to batteries for approximately 250 thousand electric vehicles.

The product lineup includes battery cells, modules, packs, and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). The President Director of IBC also ensured that the market is ready to absorb it: buyers are already in place and trial production is underway at the factory.

Peak of Nickel Downstreaming

The inauguration of the Karawang plant will make it the second battery ecosystem factory in Indonesia. The first facility involved LG and was built when Bahlil was still serving as Minister of Investment. CATIB's presence marks a gradual shift in Indonesia's nickel value chain: from ore smelting and intermediate products such as ferronickel and nickel matte, toward battery cell assembly, which carries far greater added value.

This momentum aligns with the bright outlook for downstream trade. Bloomberg Technoz (21/10/2026) reports that Indonesia's nickel and lithium battery component exports in 2026 are projected to surpass Rp899 trillion, while InvestorTrust (19/10/2026) notes that global nickel demand is projected to rise 21.39 percent.

For international readers, the message is clear: Indonesia is no longer merely exporting raw materials. With two battery ecosystem plants and an integrated supply chain from mine to cell, Indonesia is positioning itself as one of the world's electric vehicle battery manufacturing hubs.

item.title: Juventus Held 2-2 by Rennes in Europa League
item.description: Juventus drew 2-2 with Stade Rennais on Europa League matchday 3 at Allianz Stadium, Thursday (23/10/2026) early morning WIB. Zeki Çelik (5') and Nick Woltemade's penalty (67') were cancelled out by Mousa Al Tamari (15') and Boulaye Dia's penalty (43'). Juventus have seven points from three league-phase games.
item.content:encoded:
Drama-Filled First Half

Juventus failed to win at home. Hosting Stade Rennais on matchday 3 of the 2026/2027 UEFA Europa League league phase at Allianz Stadium, Thursday (23/10/2026) early morning WIB, the Bianconeri had to settle for a 2-2 draw with the visitors from France.

Juventus struck early through Zeki Çelik in the 5th minute. But Rennes turned the game around before half-time: Mousa Al Tamari levelled in the 15th minute from Bryan Reynolds' pass, before Boulaye Dia converted a penalty in the 43rd minute to put the visitors 2-1 up. Çelik's early strike briefly had Allianz Stadium roaring, but Rennes' two replies silenced the home crowd.

Woltemade's Penalty Rescues a Point

Juventus hit back after the break. The hosts' pressure paid off in the 67th minute when Nick Woltemade calmly converted a penalty to make it 2-2. The score held until the final whistle despite Juventus pushing for a winner, including a VAR check in the 89th minute. Woltemade, on loan at Juventus from Newcastle United since the summer, rescued his side once again.

Federico Gatti's 19th-minute booking, goalkeeper Brice Samba's 20th-minute injury — he returned a minute later — and Al Tamari's 32nd-minute injury all marked the game. Rennes stayed disciplined in a 5-3-2 shape and nearly stole the win on the counter.

Seven Points from Three Games

The draw takes Juventus to seven points from three league-phase games, after a 5-0 win over NEC Nijmegen and a 2-1 victory at Celta Vigo. Rennes have five points from a goalless draw with Sturm Graz, a 2-1 win over OFI Crete, and the draw in Turin.

Failing to win at home is a concern for Juventus, who also lost 0-3 to Lazio in Serie A last weekend. Statistically, Juventus edged possession 51%-49% and both sides earned five corners, while Rennes actually managed more shots on target (5 to 4). A packed schedule awaits, with no less demanding away fixtures in both domestic and European competition.

item.title: Kanye West: 360-Degree Dome Stage Ready at GBK, Concert on October 24
item.description: Raw Vision Collective promoter has confirmed that Kanye West's viral 360-degree dome stage (globe) is ready at GBK Main Stadium for the YE Live in Jakarta concert on Saturday, October 24, 2026 — Ye's debut performance in Indonesia and the only Southeast Asian city on his official tour.
item.content:encoded:
Dome Stage Ready Two Days Before Concert

JAKARTA — Promoter Raw Vision Collective has confirmed that the viral 360-degree dome stage (globe) belonging to Kanye West is ready to be installed at Gelora Bung Karno (GBK) Main Stadium, Senayan, Central Jakarta. The giant spherical stage will be used for the concert titled YE Live in Jakarta on Saturday, October 24, 2026.

The news of the stage readiness was delivered by Marketing & Communications Lead of Raw Vision Collective, Karen Tjahja, at a press conference in the SCBD area, South Jakarta, Thursday (22/10/2026). According to her, the concert production preparations have been going very well and all performance needs have been prepared.

Globe Specs Same as Other Countries

Karen ensured that the size of the globe used in Jakarta was exactly the same as on Ye's stage in other countries, so the audience would not get a smaller experience. "And the size of the globe is exactly the same as in other countries," said Karen.

He also revealed the challenges of bringing the dome stage to Indonesia. Ye's team was said to be directly involved in production preparations with highly detailed specifications, while all the globe props were flown in specifically from abroad.

Regarding stage readiness, Karen said she had directly seen the condition of the globe inside the closed preparation area for recording. "With my own eyes last night, the globe was already ready," she said.

Besides the main stage, the promoter has set up additional LED screens so that the audience can watch Ye's performance from various angles of GBK Main Stadium.

Layered Security and Extended Transport

Ahead of the concert, Raw Vision Collective deployed more than 2,000 security personnel stationed from inside the ring road to inside the stadium. The promoter also coordinated with the DKI Jakarta Provincial Government and the National Police Headquarters to ensure the security and smooth running of the event.

Security is a top priority as several other events are taking place in the GBK area in close succession. The promoter has coordinated with organizers of other events to anticipate congestion.

To reduce congestion, spectators are urged to use public transportation. MRT Jakarta is extending operating hours until 01:30 WIB on the concert day, accompanied by increased trip frequency for the return flow. TransJakarta is adding trip frequency and bus capacity, while Bluebird Group is adding taxi fleets inside the event area.

Premiere and Only Concert in Southeast Asia

The October 24, 2026 concert will mark the debut performance of Ye — the stage name of Kanye West — in Indonesia. Jakarta is also the only Southeast Asian city included in Ye's official tour, making this concert a magnet for fans from various countries.

Official concert tickets are on sale starting at Rp1,875,000 via yejakarta.com and Loket.com.

item.title: Bournemouth Thrash AC Milan 3-0 in Europa League
item.description: Bournemouth beat AC Milan 3-0 on Europa League matchday 3 at Vitality Stadium, Friday (23/10/2026) early morning WIB. Penalties from Justin Kluivert (8') and Marcus Tavernier (32') plus Amine Adli's goal (84') sealed the win; Milan goalkeeper Mike Maignan was sent off in the 27th minute.
item.content:encoded:
Kluivert and Tavernier Strike from the Spot

Bournemouth were dominant from the opening minutes. Hosting AC Milan on matchday 3 of the 2026/2027 UEFA Europa League league phase at Vitality Stadium, Friday (23/10/2026) early morning WIB, the hosts took the lead in the 8th minute: Evanilson was fouled in the box in the 6th minute, VAR confirmed the decision, and Justin Kluivert calmly converted the penalty.

Disaster struck Milan in the 27th minute. Goalkeeper Mike Maignan shoved Tyler Adams in the face with both hands as Bournemouth prepared to take a corner. Referee Vassilis Fotias immediately produced a red card and awarded a second penalty to the hosts; the decision was confirmed by VAR. Backup goalkeeper Lorenzo Torriani came on in the 32nd minute for Omari Hutchinson, but Marcus Tavernier beat him from the spot anyway. The first half ended 2-0.

Maignan Sent Off for Shoving Adams

The red-card incident was the game's turning point. Adams stood directly in front of Maignan at the corner, and the goalkeeper's reaction was excessive: a two-handed shove to the face of the US international left him on the ground. Fotias had no hesitation in showing a straight red, while Adams himself was booked in the 29th minute for his role in the incident.

The match also pitted two USMNT teammates against each other: Adams started in Bournemouth's midfield, while Yunus Musah started for Milan. Christian Pulisic, the Americans' other star, began the game on the Rossoneri bench. Down to 10 men from the 27th minute, Milan were virtually unable to escape the hosts' pressure.

Adli Seals Emphatic 3-0 Win

Bournemouth did not ease off in the second half. Amine Adli, introduced in the 77th minute for Alex Tóth, scored the third goal in the 84th minute to seal the emphatic 3-0 victory. The scoreline stood until the final whistle.

The hosts' dominance was reflected clearly in the numbers: 64%-36% possession, 20 shots to 3, seven on target to none for Milan, and expected goals of 3.18 to 0.17. AC Milan left England without a single shot on target and with a costly red card — a night to forget for Ruben Amorim's side.
